# Neuron — AI Learning Portal
# https://neurontsa.vercel.app
# TSA High School Webmaster 2026-27

## What this site is
Neuron is a free, interactive AI literacy course for high school students (grades 9-12).
It was built for the TSA (Technology Student Association) High School Webmaster event 2026-27,
whose theme is: design an AI learning portal that demystifies AI, showcases practical tools,
and teaches ethical use in academic settings.

## Content
The site contains three required learning modules (plus four bonus modules), each with five steps:
article, flashcards, video, mini-game, and quiz. Completing steps earns XP; passing quizzes
unlocks 3D badges.

Core modules:
- AI Fundamentals: what AI is, machine learning, neural networks, LLMs, hallucinations
- Practical AI Tools & Techniques: how to use AI tools effectively and ethically in school
- Ethical AI Usage: bias, fairness, academic integrity, data privacy, responsible use

Challenges (interactive games):
- Hallucination Hunt: spot fabricated claims in a fake AI answer
- Ethics Courtroom: read a scenario, pick a verdict, see the rubric
- Bias Detective: trace an AI output back to its root bias cause
- Debug the AI: find where a pipeline broke (prompt, data, generation, or interpretation)
- Concept Map Builder: connect AI terms into correct relationships
- Ethics Story: branching choose-your-own-adventure with ethical consequences
- Adaptive Quiz: difficulty adjusts to your answers
- Duel Mode: real-time multiplayer quiz against a classmate

## Technical
Stack: React 19 + TypeScript + Vite 8 + Tailwind CSS 3 + React Router 7 + Framer Motion + Three.js
Backend: Supabase (auth, progress sync, leaderboard)
AI assistant: Groq API (proxied via Supabase Edge Function; never exposes the key to the browser)
Deploy: Vercel
Fonts: Inter Tight + Newsreader (self-hosted, OFL-1.1)
